packages.label: דַּעַת וְאַהֲבָה — חַיִּים, כֹּהֵן, וְחֶסֶד
packages.label_en: Da'at and Love — Life, the Kohen, and Chesed
packages.reason: All four concepts share the essential nature of the inner holy knowing (da'at) as love and life-force. חיים and דעת are declared identical: 'חַיִּים הוּא בְּחִינַת דַּעַת' — life IS an aspect of da'at, for 'מְקוֹר חַיִּים שֵׂכֶל בְּעָלָיו' (Proverbs 16:22). כהן and חסד are declared identical: 'כֹּהֵן הוּא בְּחִינוֹת חֶסֶד.' The חסד/אהבה identity is explicit throughout the text ('הַחֶסֶד הַיְנוּ הָאַהֲבָה'). The link between the two sub-clusters (חיים-דעת and כהן-חסד) is bechina, not eitza: da'at is the inner cognitive face of love ('אַהֲבָה שֶׁבְּדַעַת'), and chesed is the relational face of the same reality. Both are expressions of the same essential quality — the holy ahavah that God has for Israel, which is simultaneously the life-force of da'at and the generous outpouring of chesed. The kohen 'guards da'at' (יִשְׁמְרוּ דַּעַת) not as a cause-effect chain but because the kohen IS chesed IS love — and love IS da'at IS life. The entire Torah is built on this single good cluster: the ahavah-she-b'da'at that underlies all of existence.

merge_notes.reason: The bechina subgraph for Torah #33 contains exactly 2 edges forming 2 isolated 2-node components: CC-A (חיים ↔ דעת, edge 763) and CC-B (כהן ↔ חסד, edge 1201). Both components are of equal size (2 nodes each); neither is 'larger.' The merge rule applies to small components (1-2 nodes), which both are. Merge criterion: SHARED NATURE, not eitza. The two sub-clusters share the essential nature of the holy ahavah-she-b'da'at that is the Torah's central concept. The source text explicitly equates chesed with ahavah ('הַחֶסֶד הַיְנוּ הָאַהֲבָה') and da'at with life ('חַיִּים הוּא בְּחִינַת דַּעַת'). The teaching's climax at section ז (lines 43-45) puts all four nodes into one conceptual frame: 'מִי הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים' — חפץ (desire) = לב (heart); חַיִּים = דַּעַת. The kohen who has chesed guards da'at (שמירת דעת). The essential nature of da'at-as-love and chesed-as-da'at makes these two 2-node clusters faces of the same good reality. Merging is by shared nature, not cause-effect.
